mechanism: AVPlayerUtils' timeUpdate callback writes the millisecond-precision playback position into the global PLAY_TIME AppStorage state on every callback (about 10 times per second). The full player page binds PLAY_TIME via @StorageProp, so the heavy player view (cover art, controls, lyrics entry) re-renders at callback frequency even though the displayed progress only changes once per second, wasting UI-thread CPU during playback and draining battery.
fix_summary: The global state is written only when the whole-second part of the position changes (seek still updates immediately).

performance_oracle.definition: Sampled retired-instruction period sum (hw-instructions) attributed to the app process in the complete externally driven measured window.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
